meta.title: DeepSeek Taiji Skin
meta.description: An ink-wash, gold and violet Taiji skin for the Web GUI: light and dark design tokens, taiji marks, a bagua star trail with clear skies, a motto with a two-line inscription, a five-second bagua boot curtain, taiji send button and send burst, and a daily divination tablet whose talisman cast leaves a hexagram slip.
